Scenarios — details

annotations-off Capability: no custom annotation leaks when unset (OFF) PASS
Description
Renders the product chart with NO annotation override and asserts that the custom annotation key (example.com/owner) is absent from every rendered object's metadata. Since the chart has no extraAnnotations/commonAnnotations knob and the default render never emits this annotation, this scenario is EXPECTED to PASS — confirming no annotation leakage.
Cluster
kind
Mechanisms
capability:annotations
Tags
capabilitycompliance
Labels
customer=enterprise profile=compliance
Artifacts
Scenario YAML
scenario.yaml 884 B · 23 ln
View full file 
---
id: annotations-off
name: "Capability: no custom annotation leaks when unset (OFF)"
description: >-
  Renders the product chart with NO annotation override and asserts that the custom annotation key (example.com/owner) is absent from every rendered object's metadata. Since the chart has no extraAnnotations/commonAnnotations knob and the default render never emits this annotation, this scenario is EXPECTED to PASS — confirming no annotation leakage.
labels: {customer: enterprise, profile: compliance}
cluster:
  provider: kind
  k8s_version: v1.30.0
product:
  chart: ./chart
  release: sample
  namespace: sample
  set:
    ingress.enabled: true
asserts:
  - type: smoke-script
    path: chart-test/assertions/annotations-absent.sh
tags: [capability, compliance]
category: capability
capability: annotate-all-objects
tier: capability
mechanisms: ["capability:annotations"]

helm_values:
  {replicaCount: 1, image: {repository: nginx, tag: "1.27-alpine"}, service: {type: ClusterIP, port: 80}, tls: {enabled: false, secretName: "", servicePort: 443,
      # -- Filesystem path where TLS cert+key are mounted. Defaults to /etc/tls.
      mountPath: "",
      # -- Volume type for the TLS material. Supported: secret (default), persistentVolumeClaim, projected, csi.
      volumeType: "secret",
      # -- PVC claim name (required when volumeType is persistentVolumeClaim).
      pvcClaimName: "",
      # -- SecretProviderClass name (required when volumeType is csi).
      secretProviderClass: "",
      # -- Whether to run the wait-for-tls initContainer that polls for cert files. Disable for CSI volumes that are populated asynchronously.
      waitForCerts: true},
    # -- Scope component (API server). Creates a separate Deployment + Service on port 8080.
    scope: {enabled: false, replicaCount: 1, image: {repository: nginx, tag: "1.27-alpine"}, service: {port: 8080}},
    # -- Darkroom component (async processor). Creates a separate Deployment with optional PVC mount.
    darkroom: {enabled: false, replicaCount: 1, image: {repository: nginx, tag: "1.27-alpine"}, pvc: {enabled: false, claimName: "", mountPath: /data}},
    # -- Ingress resource for skywatcher Service.
    ingress: {enabled: false, className: "nginx", host: "", path: /, pathType: Prefix},
    # -- HTTPRoute resource for Gateway API integration.
    gatewayRoute: {enabled: false, parentRef: {name: envoy, namespace: "", sectionName: ""}, hostname: ""},
    # -- Service mesh integration.
    mesh: {inject: false},
    # -- Policy compliance labels applied to pod templates.
    policy: {complianceLabels: {}}, ingress.enabled: true}

---
id: annotations-on
name: "Capability: custom annotations stamped on every object (ON)"
description: >-
  Renders the product chart with a global annotation knob set (extraAnnotations.example\.com/owner=team-x) and asserts every rendered object (all kinds) carries the configured annotation at .metadata.annotations. The sample chart does NOT expose an extraAnnotations/commonAnnotations knob — this scenario is EXPECTED to FAIL (honest red gap) documenting that the chart lacks global annotation propagation.
labels: {customer: enterprise, profile: compliance}
cluster:
  provider: kind
  k8s_version: v1.30.0
product:
  chart: ./chart
  release: sample
  namespace: sample
  set:
    ingress.enabled: true
    "extraAnnotations.example\\.com/owner": team-x
asserts:
  - type: annotations-present
    namespace: sample
    source: rendered
    annotations:
      example.com/owner: team-x
tags: [capability, compliance, curated-live]
category: capability
capability: annotate-all-objects
tier: capability
mechanisms: ["capability:annotations"]

      volumeType: "secret",

scenario.yaml 1287 B · 46 ln

---
id: certificates-cert-manager-jks-pkcs12
name: "cert-manager JKS/PKCS12 keystore bundle"
description: "Installs cert-manager with a self-signed ClusterIssuer, issues a Certificate, wraps tls.crt+tls.key into a PKCS12 bundle, and stores as a new Secret alongside the TLS material."
labels: {customer: any, profile: tls}
cluster:
  provider: kind
  k8s_version: v1.30.0
  preinstall:
    - kind: helm
      chart: jetstack/cert-manager
      version: v1.14.0
      release: cert-manager
      namespace: cert-manager
      repo:
        name: jetstack
        url: "https://charts.jetstack.io"
      values:
        installCRDs: true
      wait: pods-ready
      wait_timeout: 3m
    - kind: raw_manifest
      path: ./fixtures/selfsigned-clusterissuer.yaml
    - kind: raw_manifest
      path: ./fixtures/jks-tls-certificate.yaml
      namespace: sample
product:
  chart: ./chart
  release: sample
  namespace: sample
  set:
    tls.enabled: "false"
asserts:
  - type: helm-status-deployed
    release: sample
    namespace: sample
  - type: pods-ready
    namespace: sample
    timeout: 3m
  - type: smoke-script
    path: chart-test/assertions/cert-manager-jks-pkcs12.sh
tags: [nightly]
mechanisms: ['addon:cert-manager']
category: certificates
integration: cert-manager
tier: live

helm_values:
  {replicaCount: 1, image: {repository: nginx, tag: "1.27-alpine"}, service: {type: ClusterIP, port: 80}, tls: {enabled: false, secretName: "", servicePort: 443,
      # -- Filesystem path where TLS cert+key are mounted. Defaults to /etc/tls.
      mountPath: "",
      # -- Volume type for the TLS material. Supported: secret (default), persistentVolumeClaim, projected, csi.
      volumeType: "secret",
      # -- PVC claim name (required when volumeType is persistentVolumeClaim).
      pvcClaimName: "",
      # -- SecretProviderClass name (required when volumeType is csi).
      secretProviderClass: "",
      # -- Whether to run the wait-for-tls initContainer that polls for cert files. Disable for CSI volumes that are populated asynchronously.
      waitForCerts: true},
    # -- Scope component (API server). Creates a separate Deployment + Service on port 8080.
    scope: {enabled: false, replicaCount: 1, image: {repository: nginx, tag: "1.27-alpine"}, service: {port: 8080}},
    # -- Darkroom component (async processor). Creates a separate Deployment with optional PVC mount.
    darkroom: {enabled: false, replicaCount: 1, image: {repository: nginx, tag: "1.27-alpine"}, pvc: {enabled: false, claimName: "", mountPath: /data}},
    # -- Ingress resource for skywatcher Service.
    ingress: {enabled: false, className: "nginx", host: "", path: /, pathType: Prefix},
    # -- HTTPRoute resource for Gateway API integration.
    gatewayRoute: {enabled: false, parentRef: {name: envoy, namespace: "", sectionName: ""}, hostname: ""},
    # -- Service mesh integration.
    mesh: {inject: false},
    # -- Policy compliance labels applied to pod templates.
    policy: {complianceLabels: {}}, tls.enabled: "false"}

scenario.yaml 1449 B · 50 ln

---
id: certificates-cert-manager-lets-encrypt-staging
name: "cert-manager Let's Encrypt staging issuer"
description: "Installs cert-manager with Let's Encrypt staging ACME issuer. Verifies ClusterIssuer Ready=True and uses self-signed fallback Certificate to confirm chart pods serve TLS."
labels: {customer: any, profile: tls}
cluster:
  provider: kind
  k8s_version: v1.30.0
  preinstall:
    - kind: helm
      chart: jetstack/cert-manager
      version: v1.14.0
      release: cert-manager
      namespace: cert-manager
      repo:
        name: jetstack
        url: "https://charts.jetstack.io"
      values:
        installCRDs: true
      wait: pods-ready
      wait_timeout: 3m
    - kind: raw_manifest
      path: ./fixtures/selfsigned-clusterissuer.yaml
    - kind: raw_manifest
      path: ./fixtures/letsencrypt-staging-clusterissuer.yaml
    - kind: raw_manifest
      path: ./fixtures/sample-tls-certificate.yaml
      namespace: sample
product:
  chart: ./chart
  release: sample
  namespace: sample
  set:
    tls.enabled: "true"
    tls.secretName: sample-tls
    tls.servicePort: "443"
asserts:
  - type: helm-status-deployed
    release: sample
    namespace: sample
  - type: pods-ready
    namespace: sample
    timeout: 5m
  - type: smoke-script
    path: chart-test/assertions/cert-manager-letsencrypt-staging.sh
tags: [nightly]
mechanisms: ['addon:cert-manager']
category: certificates
integration: cert-manager
tier: live

scenario.yaml 1323 B · 48 ln

---
id: certificates-cert-manager-self-signed-ca
name: "cert-manager self-signed CA issuer"
description: "Installs cert-manager, creates a self-signed ClusterIssuer, issues a Certificate for the product Service FQDN, and verifies HTTPS serving with --cacert."
labels: {customer: any, profile: tls}
cluster:
  provider: kind
  k8s_version: v1.30.0
  preinstall:
    - kind: helm
      chart: jetstack/cert-manager
      version: v1.14.0
      release: cert-manager
      namespace: cert-manager
      repo:
        name: jetstack
        url: "https://charts.jetstack.io"
      values:
        installCRDs: true
      wait: pods-ready
      wait_timeout: 3m
    - kind: raw_manifest
      path: ./fixtures/selfsigned-clusterissuer.yaml
    - kind: raw_manifest
      path: ./fixtures/sample-tls-certificate.yaml
      namespace: sample
product:
  chart: ./chart
  release: sample
  namespace: sample
  set:
    tls.enabled: "true"
    tls.secretName: sample-tls
    tls.servicePort: "443"
asserts:
  - type: helm-status-deployed
    release: sample
    namespace: sample
  - type: pods-ready
    namespace: sample
    timeout: 5m
  - type: smoke-script
    path: chart-test/assertions/cert-manager-self-signed.sh
tags: [nightly]
mechanisms: ['addon:cert-manager']
category: certificates
integration: cert-manager
tier: live

scenario.yaml 1267 B · 46 ln

---
id: certificates-cert-manager-wildcard
name: "cert-manager wildcard certificate"
description: "Installs cert-manager with a self-signed ClusterIssuer, issues a wildcard Certificate with SAN DNS:*.test.local + test.local, and verifies both SANs are present."
labels: {customer: any, profile: tls}
cluster:
  provider: kind
  k8s_version: v1.30.0
  preinstall:
    - kind: helm
      chart: jetstack/cert-manager
      version: v1.14.0
      release: cert-manager
      namespace: cert-manager
      repo:
        name: jetstack
        url: "https://charts.jetstack.io"
      values:
        installCRDs: true
      wait: pods-ready
      wait_timeout: 3m
    - kind: raw_manifest
      path: ./fixtures/selfsigned-clusterissuer.yaml
    - kind: raw_manifest
      path: ./fixtures/wildcard-tls-certificate.yaml
      namespace: sample
product:
  chart: ./chart
  release: sample
  namespace: sample
  set:
    tls.enabled: "false"
asserts:
  - type: helm-status-deployed
    release: sample
    namespace: sample
  - type: pods-ready
    namespace: sample
    timeout: 3m
  - type: smoke-script
    path: chart-test/assertions/cert-manager-wildcard.sh
tags: [nightly]
mechanisms: ['addon:cert-manager']
category: certificates
integration: cert-manager
tier: live

---
id: certificates-manual-tls-secret-basic
name: "manual-tls-secret basic"
description: "Delivers a pre-provisioned TLS Secret (RSA 2048) via raw_manifest preinstall and verifies the chart serves HTTPS with it. No cert-manager dependency."
labels: {customer: any, profile: tls}
cluster:
  provider: kind
  k8s_version: v1.30.0
  preinstall:
    - kind: raw_manifest
      path: ./fixtures/manual-tls-basic-secret.yaml
      namespace: sample
product:
  chart: ./chart
  release: sample
  namespace: sample
  set:
    tls.enabled: "true"
    tls.secretName: manual-tls-basic
    tls.servicePort: "443"
asserts:
  - type: helm-status-deployed
    release: sample
    namespace: sample
  - type: pods-ready
    namespace: sample
    timeout: 5m
  - type: smoke-script
    path: chart-test/assertions/manual-tls-basic.sh
tags: [nightly]
mechanisms: ['addon:manual-tls-secret']
category: certificates
integration: manual-tls-secret
tier: live

---
id: certificates-manual-tls-secret-ecdsa
name: "manual-tls-secret ECDSA key"
description: "Delivers a pre-provisioned TLS Secret with ECDSA P-256 key via raw_manifest. Verifies cert has id-ecPublicKey algorithm and pods serve HTTPS with the ECDSA key."
labels: {customer: any, profile: tls}
cluster:
  provider: kind
  k8s_version: v1.30.0
  preinstall:
    - kind: raw_manifest
      path: ./fixtures/manual-tls-ecdsa-secret.yaml
      namespace: sample
product:
  chart: ./chart
  release: sample
  namespace: sample
  set:
    tls.enabled: "true"
    tls.secretName: manual-tls-ecdsa
    tls.servicePort: "443"
asserts:
  - type: helm-status-deployed
    release: sample
    namespace: sample
  - type: pods-ready
    namespace: sample
    timeout: 5m
  - type: smoke-script
    path: chart-test/assertions/manual-tls-ecdsa.sh
tags: [nightly]
mechanisms: ['addon:manual-tls-secret']
category: certificates
integration: manual-tls-secret
tier: live

  data:
    default.conf: |
      server {
        listen 80;
        server_name _;
        location / {
          root /usr/share/nginx/html;
          index index.html;
        }
      }
      server {
        listen 443 ssl;
        server_name _;
        ssl_certificate     /etc/tls/tls.crt;
        ssl_certificate_key /etc/tls/tls.key;
        location / {
          root /usr/share/nginx/html;
          index index.html;
        }
      }

---
id: certificates-manual-tls-secret-multiple-sans
name: "manual-tls-secret multiple SANs"
description: "Delivers a pre-provisioned TLS Secret with 3 DNS SANs (sample.sample.svc, api.sample.sample.svc, admin.sample.sample.svc) via raw_manifest and verifies the cert has >=2 SAN entries."
labels: {customer: any, profile: tls}
cluster:
  provider: kind
  k8s_version: v1.30.0
  preinstall:
    - kind: raw_manifest
      path: ./fixtures/manual-tls-multisite-secret.yaml
      namespace: sample
product:
  chart: ./chart
  release: sample
  namespace: sample
  set:
    tls.enabled: "true"
    tls.secretName: manual-tls-multisite
    tls.servicePort: "443"
asserts:
  - type: helm-status-deployed
    release: sample
    namespace: sample
  - type: pods-ready
    namespace: sample
    timeout: 5m
  - type: smoke-script
    path: chart-test/assertions/manual-tls-multiple-sans.sh
tags: [nightly]
mechanisms: ['addon:manual-tls-secret']
category: certificates
integration: manual-tls-secret
tier: live

certificates-mounted-tls-certs-csi-secret-store mounted-tls-certs csi-secret-store PASS
Description
Installs the secrets-store-csi-driver helm chart and a stub SecretProviderClass, then installs the chart with a TLS secret volume. Verifies CSI driver presence, SecretProviderClass resource, and that the product pod serves HTTPS. Full CSI volume mount verification requires a real CSI provider plugin (e.g. AWS Secrets Manager, GCP Secret Manager, Azure Key Vault, or HashiCorp Vault) which is not available on kind; the scenario validates CSI infrastructure deployment and documents the mount verification as a SKIP on kind.
Cluster
kind
Preinstalled
csi-secrets-store
Mechanisms
addon:mounted-tls-certs

nightly
Labels
customer=any profile=tls

scenario.yaml 1938 B · 53 ln

---
id: certificates-mounted-tls-certs-csi-secret-store
name: "mounted-tls-certs csi-secret-store"
description: >-
  Installs the secrets-store-csi-driver helm chart and a stub SecretProviderClass, then installs the chart with a TLS secret volume. Verifies CSI driver presence, SecretProviderClass resource, and that the product pod serves HTTPS. Full CSI volume mount verification requires a real CSI provider plugin (e.g. AWS Secrets Manager, GCP Secret Manager, Azure Key Vault, or HashiCorp Vault) which is not available on kind; the scenario validates CSI infrastructure deployment and documents the mount verification as a SKIP on kind.
labels: {customer: any, profile: tls}
cluster:
  provider: kind
  k8s_version: v1.30.0
  preinstall:
    - kind: helm
      chart: secrets-store-csi-driver/secrets-store-csi-driver
      version: 1.4.8
      release: csi-secrets-store
      namespace: kube-system
      repo:
        name: secrets-store-csi-driver
        url: "https://kubernetes-sigs.github.io/secrets-store-csi-driver/charts"
      values:
        syncSecret:
          enabled: true
        enableSecretRotation: false
      wait: pods-ready
      wait_timeout: 5m

---
id: certificates-mounted-tls-certs-projected-volume
name: "mounted-tls-certs projected-volume"
description: "Creates a TLS Secret, then installs the chart using a projected volume that projects the Secret into the pod. Verifies projected volume source and HTTPS serving."
labels: {customer: any, profile: tls}
cluster:
  provider: kind
  k8s_version: v1.30.0
  preinstall:
    - kind: raw_manifest
      path: ./fixtures/mounted-tls-projected-secret.yaml
      namespace: sample
product:
  chart: ./chart
  release: sample
  namespace: sample
  set:
    tls.enabled: "true"
    tls.secretName: "mounted-tls-projected"
    tls.servicePort: "443"
    tls.volumeType: "projected"
asserts:
  - type: helm-status-deployed
    release: sample
    namespace: sample
  - type: pods-ready
    namespace: sample
    timeout: 5m
  - type: smoke-script
    path: chart-test/assertions/mounted-tls-projected-volume.sh
tags: [nightly]
mechanisms: ['addon:mounted-tls-certs']
category: certificates
integration: mounted-tls-certs
tier: live

    default.conf: |
      server {
        listen 80;
        server_name _;
        location / {
          root /usr/share/nginx/html;
          index index.html;
        }
      }
      server {
        listen 443 ssl;
        server_name _;
        ssl_certificate     /etc/tls/tls.crt;
        ssl_certificate_key /etc/tls/tls.key;
        location / {
          root /usr/share/nginx/html;
          index index.html;
        }
      }

---
id: certificates-mounted-tls-certs-pvc-mount
name: "mounted-tls-certs pvc-mount"
description: "Creates a PVC, populates it with TLS certs via a Job, then installs the chart with a persistentVolumeClaim-backed TLS volume. Verifies the pod mount and HTTPS serving."
labels: {customer: any, profile: tls}
cluster:
  provider: kind
  k8s_version: v1.30.0
  preinstall:
    - kind: raw_manifest
      path: ./fixtures/mounted-tls-pvc.yaml
      namespace: sample
    - kind: raw_manifest
      path: ./fixtures/mounted-tls-pvc-certs-configmap.yaml
      namespace: sample
    - kind: raw_manifest
      path: ./fixtures/mounted-tls-populate-job.yaml
      namespace: sample
product:
  chart: ./chart
  release: sample
  namespace: sample
  set:

---
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: populate-mounted-tls-pvc
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      restartPolicy: Never
      containers:
        - name: populate
          image: busybox:1.36
          command:
            - sh
            - -c
            - |
              base64 -d /certs-in/tls.crt.b64 > /certs-out/tls.crt
              base64 -d /certs-in/tls.key.b64 > /certs-out/tls.key
              chmod 644 /certs-out/tls.crt /certs-out/tls.key
              echo "TLS certs written to PVC"
              ls -la /certs-out/
              [ -f /certs-out/tls.crt ] && [ -s /certs-out/tls.crt ] && echo "tls.crt OK" || { echo "FAIL: tls.crt missing or empty"; exit 1; }
              [ -f /certs-out/tls.key ] && [ -s /certs-out/tls.key ] && echo "tls.key OK" || { echo "FAIL: tls.key missing or empty"; exit 1; }
          volumeMounts:
            - name: certs-in
              mountPath: /certs-in
            - name: certs-out
              mountPath: /certs-out
      volumes:
        - name: certs-in
          configMap:
            name: mounted-tls-pvc-certs
        - name: certs-out
          persistentVolumeClaim:
            claimName: mounted-tls-pvc

- apiVersion: v1
  data:
    default.conf: |
      server {
        listen 80;
        server_name _;
        location / {
          root /usr/share/nginx/html;
          index index.html;
        }
      }
      server {
        listen 443 ssl;
        server_name _;
        ssl_certificate     /etc/tls/tls.crt;
        ssl_certificate_key /etc/tls/tls.key;
        location / {
          root /usr/share/nginx/html;
          index index.html;
        }
      }

---
id: cni-cilium-ebpf-kube-proxy-replacement
name: "Cilium eBPF kube-proxy replacement"
description: "Proves full eBPF kube-proxy replacement on kind: Cilium replaces kube-proxy, product ClusterIP reachable through eBPF datapath."
labels: {customer: any, profile: cni}
cluster:
  provider: kind
  config: ./fixtures/kind-cilium.yaml
  cni:
    provider: cilium
    kube_proxy_replacement: true
product:
  chart: ./chart
  release: sample
  namespace: sample
  set:
    image.repository: "public.ecr.aws/nginx/nginx"
    image.tag: "1.27-alpine"
    ingress.enabled: "false"
asserts:
  - type: helm-status-deployed
    release: sample
    namespace: sample
  - type: pods-ready
    namespace: sample
    timeout: 5m
  - type: smoke-script
    path: chart-test/assertions/cni/cilium-ebpf.sh
tags: [nightly]
mechanisms: ['addon:cilium']
category: cni

      # -- Filesystem path where TLS cert+key are mounted. Defaults to /etc/tls.
      mountPath: "",
      # -- Volume type for the TLS material. Supported: secret (default), persistentVolumeClaim, projected, csi.
      volumeType: "secret",
      # -- PVC claim name (required when volumeType is persistentVolumeClaim).
      pvcClaimName: "",
      # -- SecretProviderClass name (required when volumeType is csi).
      secretProviderClass: "",
      # -- Whether to run the wait-for-tls initContainer that polls for cert files. Disable for CSI volumes that are populated asynchronously.
      waitForCerts: true},
    # -- Scope component (API server). Creates a separate Deployment + Service on port 8080.
    scope: {enabled: false, replicaCount: 1, image: {repository: nginx, tag: "1.27-alpine"}, service: {port: 8080}},
    # -- Darkroom component (async processor). Creates a separate Deployment with optional PVC mount.
    darkroom: {enabled: false, replicaCount: 1, image: {repository: nginx, tag: "1.27-alpine"}, pvc: {enabled: false, claimName: "", mountPath: /data}},

---
id: cni-cilium-ingress
name: "Cilium ingress controller — dedicated loadbalancerMode"
description: "Proves the Cilium ingress controller in dedicated loadbalancerMode on kind: per-Ingress Service routes HTTP with matching Host header to the product Service."
labels: {customer: any, profile: cni}
cluster:
  provider: kind
  config: ./fixtures/kind-cilium.yaml
  cni:
    provider: cilium
    kube_proxy_replacement: true
    values: ./fixtures/cilium-ingress-values.yaml
product:
  chart: ./chart
  release: sample
  namespace: sample
  set:
    image.repository: "public.ecr.aws/nginx/nginx"
    image.tag: "1.27-alpine"
    ingress.enabled: "true"
    ingress.className: "cilium"
    ingress.host: "sample.test.local"
asserts:
  - type: helm-status-deployed
    release: sample
    namespace: sample
  - type: pods-ready
    namespace: sample
    timeout: 5m
  - type: smoke-script
    path: chart-test/assertions/cni/cilium-ingress.sh
tags: [nightly]
mechanisms: ['addon:cilium']
category: cni
integration: cilium
tier: live

---
id: cni-cilium-network-policy
name: "CiliumNetworkPolicy enforcement — default-deny + allow-by-label"
description: "Proves CiliumNetworkPolicy (CNP) enforcement on kind: default-deny + allow-by-label. Blocks unlabeled traffic; allows labeled clients. CNP applied as raw_manifest preinstall."
labels: {customer: any, profile: cni}
cluster:
  provider: kind
  config: ./fixtures/kind-cilium.yaml
  cni:
    provider: cilium
    kube_proxy_replacement: true
  preinstall:
    - kind: raw_manifest
      path: ./fixtures/cilium-network-policy.yaml
      namespace: sample
product:
  chart: ./chart
  release: sample
  namespace: sample
  set:
    image.repository: "public.ecr.aws/nginx/nginx"
    image.tag: "1.27-alpine"
    ingress.enabled: "false"
asserts:
  - type: helm-status-deployed
    release: sample
    namespace: sample
  - type: pods-ready
    namespace: sample
    timeout: 5m
  - type: smoke-script
    path: chart-test/assertions/cni/cilium-network-policy.sh
tags: [nightly]
mechanisms: ['addon:cilium']
category: cni
integration: cilium
tier: live

---
# CiliumNetworkPolicy fixture for cni-cilium-network-policy scenario.
# Enforces:
#   - Default-deny ingress to the product Service (drop all unmatched traffic)
#   - Allow ingress only from pods carrying label access=allowed
apiVersion: "cilium.io/v2"
kind: CiliumNetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: cncp-sample
  namespace: sample
spec:
  endpointSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/instance: sample
  ingress:
    # Allow from pods with label access=allowed (same namespace)
    - fromEndpoints:
        - matchLabels:
            access: allowed
      toPorts:
        - ports:
            - port: "80"
              protocol: TCP

scenario.yaml 1276 B · 39 ln

id: customer-a-istio
name: "Customer A — Istio mesh + cert-manager"
description: "Customer A's profile: istio sidecar injection, istio-ingress, cert-manager."
labels: {customer: A, mesh: istio, ingress: istio-gw}
cluster:
  provider: kind
  k8s_version: v1.30.0
  preinstall:
    - chart: jetstack/cert-manager
      version: v1.14.0
      release: cert-manager
      namespace: cert-manager
      repo: {name: jetstack, url: "https://charts.jetstack.io"}
      values: {installCRDs: true}
      wait: pods-ready
    - chart: istio/base
      version: 1.21.0
      release: istio-base
      namespace: istio-system
      repo: {name: istio, url: "https://istio-release.storage.googleapis.com/charts"}
      wait: helm-deployed
    - chart: istio/istiod
      version: 1.21.0
      release: istiod
      namespace: istio-system
      wait: pods-ready
product:
  chart: ./chart
  release: sample
  namespace: sample
  set: {"podAnnotations.sidecar\\.istio\\.io/inject": "true"}
asserts:
  - {type: helm-status-deployed, release: sample, namespace: sample}
  - {type: pods-ready, namespace: sample, timeout: 5m}
tags: [nightly, customer-replica]
mechanisms: ['addon:istio', 'addon:cert-manager', 'mesh:istio', 'customer:A']
category: service-mesh
integration: istio
tier: live

helm_values:
  {replicaCount: 1, image: {repository: nginx, tag: "1.27-alpine"}, service: {type: ClusterIP, port: 80}, tls: {enabled: false, secretName: "", servicePort: 443,
      # -- Filesystem path where TLS cert+key are mounted. Defaults to /etc/tls.
      mountPath: "",
      # -- Volume type for the TLS material. Supported: secret (default), persistentVolumeClaim, projected, csi.
      volumeType: "secret",
      # -- PVC claim name (required when volumeType is persistentVolumeClaim).
      pvcClaimName: "",
      # -- SecretProviderClass name (required when volumeType is csi).
      secretProviderClass: "",
      # -- Whether to run the wait-for-tls initContainer that polls for cert files. Disable for CSI volumes that are populated asynchronously.
      waitForCerts: true},
    # -- Scope component (API server). Creates a separate Deployment + Service on port 8080.
    scope: {enabled: false, replicaCount: 1, image: {repository: nginx, tag: "1.27-alpine"}, service: {port: 8080}},
    # -- Darkroom component (async processor). Creates a separate Deployment with optional PVC mount.
    darkroom: {enabled: false, replicaCount: 1, image: {repository: nginx, tag: "1.27-alpine"}, pvc: {enabled: false, claimName: "", mountPath: /data}},
    # -- Ingress resource for skywatcher Service.

id: customer-b-gatekeeper
name: "Customer B — OPA Gatekeeper admission policies"
description: "Customer B runs Gatekeeper with strict admission policies. Chart must satisfy required-labels + no-privileged constraints."
labels: {customer: B, policy: gatekeeper}
cluster:
  provider: kind
  k8s_version: v1.30.0
  preinstall:
    - chart: gatekeeper/gatekeeper
      version: 3.16.0
      release: gatekeeper
      namespace: gatekeeper-system
      repo: {name: gatekeeper, url: "https://open-policy-agent.github.io/gatekeeper/charts"}
      wait: pods-ready
product:
  chart: ./chart
  release: sample
  namespace: sample
asserts:
  - {type: helm-status-deployed, release: sample, namespace: sample}
  - {type: pods-ready, namespace: sample, timeout: 5m}
tags: [nightly, customer-replica]
mechanisms: ['addon:gatekeeper', 'customer:B']
category: policy
integration: opa-gatekeeper
tier: live

id: envoy-gateway
name: "Envoy Gateway (Gateway API)"
description: >-
  Installs Envoy Gateway controller via OCI helm chart (CRDs are bundled in the chart's crds/ directory and installed automatically by Helm before templates). Verifies chart coexists with a running gateway controller.
labels: {customer: none, profile: gateway-api}
cluster:
  provider: kind
  k8s_version: v1.30.0
  preinstall:
    - chart: oci://docker.io/envoyproxy/gateway-helm
      version: v1.1.2
      release: envoy-gateway
      namespace: envoy-gateway-system
      values:
        config:
          envoyGateway:
            provider:
              type: Kubernetes
      wait: helm-deployed
      wait_timeout: 5m
product:
  chart: ./chart
  release: sample
  namespace: sample
asserts:
  - {type: helm-status-deployed, release: envoy-gateway, namespace: envoy-gateway-system}
  - {type: helm-status-deployed, release: sample, namespace: sample}
  - {type: pods-ready, namespace: envoy-gateway-system, selector: app.kubernetes.io/name=gateway-helm, timeout: 5m}
  - {type: pods-ready, namespace: sample}
tags: [nightly]
mechanisms: ['addon:envoy-gateway', 'gateway-api:envoy']
category: gateway-api
integration: envoy-gateway
tier: live

---
id: gateway-api-contour-gateway-api-basic
name: "Contour Gateway API Basic"
description: "Installs Gateway API CRDs and Contour Gateway Provisioner, creates GatewayClass contour + Gateway + HTTPRoute, and verifies HTTP routing through the auto-provisioned Envoy proxy."
labels: {customer: any, profile: gateway-api}
cluster:
  provider: kind
  k8s_version: v1.30.0
  preinstall:
    - kind: raw_manifest
      path: https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/gateway-api/releases/download/v1.2.0/standard-install.yaml
    - kind: raw_manifest
      path: https://projectcontour.io/quickstart/contour-gateway-provisioner.yaml
product:
  chart: ./chart
  release: sample
  namespace: sample
  set:
    image.repository: "nginx"
    image.tag: "1.27-alpine"
    gatewayRoute.enabled: "false"
asserts:
  - type: helm-status-deployed
    release: sample
    namespace: sample
  - type: pods-ready
    namespace: projectcontour
    selector: control-plane=contour-gateway-provisioner
    timeout: 5m
  - type: pods-ready
    namespace: sample
    timeout: 5m
  - type: smoke-script
    path: chart-test/assertions/contour-gateway-api-basic.sh
tags: [nightly]
mechanisms: ['addon:contour', 'gateway-api:contour']
category: gateway-api
integration: contour
tier: live

---
id: gateway-api-contour-gateway-api-response-header-modifier
name: "Contour Gateway API Response Header Modifier"
description: "Installs Gateway API CRDs + Contour Gateway Provisioner, creates GatewayClass contour + Gateway + HTTPRoute with ResponseHeaderModifier filter, verifies X-Powered-By header."
labels: {customer: any, profile: gateway-api}
cluster:
  provider: kind
  k8s_version: v1.30.0
  preinstall:
    - kind: raw_manifest
      path: https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/gateway-api/releases/download/v1.2.0/standard-install.yaml
    - kind: raw_manifest
      path: https://projectcontour.io/quickstart/contour-gateway-provisioner.yaml
product:
  chart: ./chart
  release: sample
  namespace: sample
  set:
    image.repository: "nginx"
    image.tag: "1.27-alpine"
    gatewayRoute.enabled: "false"
asserts:
  - type: helm-status-deployed
    release: sample
    namespace: sample
  - type: pods-ready
    namespace: projectcontour
    selector: control-plane=contour-gateway-provisioner
    timeout: 5m
  - type: pods-ready
    namespace: sample
    timeout: 5m
  - type: smoke-script
    path: chart-test/assertions/contour-gateway-api-response-header-modifier.sh
tags: [nightly]
mechanisms: ['addon:contour', 'gateway-api:contour']
category: gateway-api
integration: contour
tier: live

      # -- Filesystem path where TLS cert+key are mounted. Defaults to /etc/tls.
      mountPath: "",
      # -- Volume type for the TLS material. Supported: secret (default), persistentVolumeClaim, projected, csi.
      volumeType: "secret",
      # -- PVC claim name (required when volumeType is persistentVolumeClaim).
      pvcClaimName: "",

      secretProviderClass: "",
      # -- Whether to run the wait-for-tls initContainer that polls for cert files. Disable for CSI volumes that are populated asynchronously.
      waitForCerts: true},
    # -- Scope component (API server). Creates a separate Deployment + Service on port 8080.
    scope: {enabled: false, replicaCount: 1, image: {repository: nginx, tag: "1.27-alpine"}, service: {port: 8080}},
    # -- Darkroom component (async processor). Creates a separate Deployment with optional PVC mount.
    darkroom: {enabled: false, replicaCount: 1, image: {repository: nginx, tag: "1.27-alpine"}, pvc: {enabled: false, claimName: "", mountPath: /data}},
    # -- Ingress resource for skywatcher Service.

    # -- HTTPRoute resource for Gateway API integration.
    gatewayRoute: {enabled: false, parentRef: {name: envoy, namespace: "", sectionName: ""}, hostname: ""},
    # -- Service mesh integration.
    mesh: {inject: false},

    policy: {complianceLabels: {}}, image.repository: "nginx", image.tag: "1.27-alpine", gatewayRoute.enabled: "false"}

---
id: gateway-api-contour-gateway-api-route-precedence
name: "Contour Gateway API Route Precedence"
description: "Installs Gateway API CRDs + Contour Gateway Provisioner, creates GatewayClass contour + Gateway + two HTTPRoutes with overlapping prefixes, verifies more specific route wins."
labels: {customer: any, profile: gateway-api}
cluster:
  provider: kind
  k8s_version: v1.30.0
  preinstall:
    - kind: raw_manifest
      path: https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/gateway-api/releases/download/v1.2.0/standard-install.yaml
    - kind: raw_manifest
      path: https://projectcontour.io/quickstart/contour-gateway-provisioner.yaml
product:
  chart: ./chart
  release: sample
  namespace: sample
  set:
    image.repository: "nginx"
    image.tag: "1.27-alpine"
    gatewayRoute.enabled: "false"
asserts:
  - type: helm-status-deployed
    release: sample
    namespace: sample
  - type: pods-ready
    namespace: projectcontour
    selector: control-plane=contour-gateway-provisioner
    timeout: 5m
  - type: pods-ready
    namespace: sample
    timeout: 5m
  - type: smoke-script
    path: chart-test/assertions/contour-gateway-api-route-precedence.sh
tags: [nightly]
mechanisms: ['addon:contour', 'gateway-api:contour']
category: gateway-api
integration: contour
tier: live

---
id: gateway-api-envoy-gateway-cert-manager-tls
name: "Envoy Gateway + cert-manager TLS"
description: "Installs cert-manager and envoy-gateway, issues a TLS certificate, creates Gateway with HTTPS listener using cert-manager Secret, and verifies HTTPS serving with expected cert."
labels: {customer: any, profile: gateway-api-tls}
cluster:
  provider: kind
  k8s_version: v1.30.0
  preinstall:
    - kind: helm
      chart: oci://docker.io/envoyproxy/gateway-helm
      version: v1.1.2
      release: envoy-gateway
      namespace: envoy-gateway-system
      values:
        config:
          envoyGateway:
            provider:
              type: Kubernetes
      wait: helm-deployed
      wait_timeout: 5m
    - kind: raw_manifest
      path: https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/gateway-api/releases/download/v1.1.0/standard-install.yaml
    - kind: helm
      chart: jetstack/cert-manager
      version: v1.14.0
      release: cert-manager
      namespace: cert-manager
      repo:
        name: jetstack
        url: "https://charts.jetstack.io"
      values:
        installCRDs: true
      wait: pods-ready
      wait_timeout: 3m
    - kind: raw_manifest
      path: ./fixtures/selfsigned-clusterissuer.yaml
product:
  chart: ./chart
  release: sample
  namespace: sample
  set:
    image.repository: "nginx"
    image.tag: "1.27-alpine"
    gatewayRoute.enabled: "true"
    gatewayRoute.parentRef.name: "sample-gw"
    gatewayRoute.parentRef.sectionName: "https"
asserts:
  - type: helm-status-deployed
    release: cert-manager
    namespace: cert-manager
  - type: helm-status-deployed
    release: envoy-gateway
    namespace: envoy-gateway-system
  - type: helm-status-deployed
    release: sample
    namespace: sample
  - type: pods-ready
    namespace: cert-manager
    timeout: 5m
  - type: pods-ready
    namespace: envoy-gateway-system
    selector: app.kubernetes.io/name=gateway-helm
    timeout: 5m
  - type: pods-ready
    namespace: sample
    timeout: 5m
  - type: smoke-script
    path: chart-test/assertions/envoy-gateway-cert-manager-tls.sh
tags: [nightly]
mechanisms: ['addon:envoy-gateway', 'addon:cert-manager', 'gateway-api:envoy']
category: gateway-api
integration: envoy-gateway
tier: live

  {replicaCount: 1, image: {repository: nginx, tag: "1.27-alpine"}, service: {type: ClusterIP, port: 80}, tls: {enabled: false, secretName: "", servicePort: 443,
      # -- Filesystem path where TLS cert+key are mounted. Defaults to /etc/tls.
      mountPath: "",
      # -- Volume type for the TLS material. Supported: secret (default), persistentVolumeClaim, projected, csi.
      volumeType: "secret",
      # -- PVC claim name (required when volumeType is persistentVolumeClaim).
      pvcClaimName: "",
      # -- SecretProviderClass name (required when volumeType is csi).
      secretProviderClass: "",
      # -- Whether to run the wait-for-tls initContainer that polls for cert files. Disable for CSI volumes that are populated asynchronously.
      waitForCerts: true},
    # -- Scope component (API server). Creates a separate Deployment + Service on port 8080.
    scope: {enabled: false, replicaCount: 1, image: {repository: nginx, tag: "1.27-alpine"}, service: {port: 8080}},
    # -- Darkroom component (async processor). Creates a separate Deployment with optional PVC mount.
    darkroom: {enabled: false, replicaCount: 1, image: {repository: nginx, tag: "1.27-alpine"}, pvc: {enabled: false, claimName: "", mountPath: /data}},
    # -- Ingress resource for skywatcher Service.
    ingress: {enabled: false, className: "nginx", host: "", path: /, pathType: Prefix},

---
id: gateway-api-envoy-gateway-grpcroute
name: "Envoy Gateway GRPCRoute"
description: "Installs Gateway API CRDs and envoy-gateway controller, deploys a gRPC backend, creates GRPCRoute, and verifies gRPC reflection through the Envoy proxy."
labels: {customer: any, profile: gateway-api}
cluster:
  provider: kind
  k8s_version: v1.30.0
  preinstall:
    - kind: helm
      chart: oci://docker.io/envoyproxy/gateway-helm
      version: v1.1.2
      release: envoy-gateway
      namespace: envoy-gateway-system
      values:
        config:
          envoyGateway:
            provider:
              type: Kubernetes
      wait: helm-deployed
      wait_timeout: 5m
    - kind: raw_manifest
      path: https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/gateway-api/releases/download/v1.1.0/standard-install.yaml
    - kind: raw_manifest
      path: ./fixtures/envoy-gateway-grpcroute-backend.yaml
      namespace: sample
product:
  chart: ./chart
  release: sample
  namespace: sample
  set:
    image.repository: "nginx"
    image.tag: "1.27-alpine"
asserts:
  - type: helm-status-deployed
    release: envoy-gateway
    namespace: envoy-gateway-system
  - type: helm-status-deployed
    release: sample
    namespace: sample
  - type: pods-ready
    namespace: envoy-gateway-system
    selector: app.kubernetes.io/name=gateway-helm
    timeout: 5m
  - type: pods-ready
    namespace: sample
    timeout: 5m
  - type: smoke-script
    path: chart-test/assertions/envoy-gateway-grpcroute.sh
tags: [nightly]
mechanisms: ['addon:envoy-gateway', 'gateway-api:envoy']
category: gateway-api
integration: envoy-gateway
tier: live

scenario.yaml 1621 B · 54 ln
View full file 
---
id: gateway-api-envoy-gateway-httproute
name: "Envoy Gateway HTTPRoute"
description: "Installs Gateway API CRDs and envoy-gateway controller, creates GatewayClass+Gateway+HTTPRoute, and verifies HTTP routing through the Envoy proxy."
labels: {customer: any, profile: gateway-api}
cluster:
  provider: kind
  k8s_version: v1.30.0
  preinstall:
    - kind: helm
      chart: oci://docker.io/envoyproxy/gateway-helm
      version: v1.1.2
      release: envoy-gateway
      namespace: envoy-gateway-system
      values:
        config:
          envoyGateway:
            provider:
              type: Kubernetes
      wait: helm-deployed
      wait_timeout: 5m
    - kind: raw_manifest
      path: https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/gateway-api/releases/download/v1.1.0/standard-install.yaml
product:
  chart: ./chart
  release: sample
  namespace: sample
  set:
    image.repository: "nginx"
    image.tag: "1.27-alpine"
    gatewayRoute.enabled: "true"
    gatewayRoute.parentRef.name: "sample-gw"
    gatewayRoute.parentRef.sectionName: "http"
asserts:
  - type: helm-status-deployed
    release: envoy-gateway
    namespace: envoy-gateway-system
  - type: helm-status-deployed
    release: sample
    namespace: sample
  - type: pods-ready
    namespace: envoy-gateway-system
    selector: app.kubernetes.io/name=gateway-helm
    timeout: 5m
  - type: pods-ready
    namespace: sample
    timeout: 5m
  - type: smoke-script
    path: chart-test/assertions/envoy-gateway-httproute.sh
tags: [nightly]
mechanisms: ['addon:envoy-gateway', 'gateway-api:envoy']
category: gateway-api
integration: envoy-gateway
tier: live

      # -- Filesystem path where TLS cert+key are mounted. Defaults to /etc/tls.
      mountPath: "",

      volumeType: "secret",

      pvcClaimName: "",

    scope: {enabled: false, replicaCount: 1, image: {repository: nginx, tag: "1.27-alpine"}, service: {port: 8080}},

---
id: gateway-api-envoy-gateway-security-policy-attach
name: "Envoy Gateway SecurityPolicy (CORS)"
description: "Installs Gateway API CRDs and envoy-gateway controller, creates HTTPRoute with SecurityPolicy (CORS) attaching to the route, and verifies CORS header on preflight."
labels: {customer: any, profile: gateway-api}
cluster:
  provider: kind
  k8s_version: v1.30.0
  preinstall:
    - kind: helm
      chart: oci://docker.io/envoyproxy/gateway-helm
      version: v1.1.2
      release: envoy-gateway
      namespace: envoy-gateway-system
      values:
        config:
          envoyGateway:
            provider:
              type: Kubernetes
      wait: helm-deployed
      wait_timeout: 5m
    - kind: raw_manifest
      path: https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/gateway-api/releases/download/v1.1.0/standard-install.yaml
product:
  chart: ./chart
  release: sample
  namespace: sample
  set:
    image.repository: "nginx"
    image.tag: "1.27-alpine"
    gatewayRoute.enabled: "true"
    gatewayRoute.parentRef.name: "sample-gw"
    gatewayRoute.parentRef.sectionName: "http"
asserts:
  - type: helm-status-deployed
    release: envoy-gateway
    namespace: envoy-gateway-system
  - type: helm-status-deployed
    release: sample
    namespace: sample
  - type: pods-ready
    namespace: envoy-gateway-system
    selector: app.kubernetes.io/name=gateway-helm
    timeout: 5m
  - type: pods-ready
    namespace: sample
    timeout: 5m
  - type: smoke-script
    path: chart-test/assertions/envoy-gateway-security-policy-attach.sh
tags: [nightly]
mechanisms: ['addon:envoy-gateway', 'gateway-api:envoy']
category: gateway-api
integration: envoy-gateway
tier: live

Installs istio/base + istio/istiod with REGISTRY_ONLY outbound policy and an egress gateway, applies a ServiceEntry + istio egress Gateway + VirtualService (raw_manifest) for httpbin.org, deploys the chart with sidecar injection, and verifies the egress infrastructure. ---
id: gateway-api-istio-egress
name: "Istio Gateway API Egress"
description: >-
  Installs istio/base + istio/istiod with REGISTRY_ONLY outbound policy and an egress gateway, applies a ServiceEntry + istio egress Gateway + VirtualService (raw_manifest) for httpbin.org, deploys the chart with sidecar injection, and verifies the egress infrastructure. Gap-probe: the chart exposes no knob to route its workload egress through the egress Gateway (no Sidecar/VirtualService from chart), and end-to-end egress proof is unverifiable for the chart-owned path. The artifact bundle documents the gap.
labels: {customer: any, profile: gateway-api}
cluster:
  provider: kind
  k8s_version: v1.30.0
  preinstall:
    # Istio base CRDs
    - kind: helm
      chart: istio/base
      version: 1.27.9
      release: istio-base
      namespace: istio-system
      repo:
        name: istio
        url: "https://istio-release.storage.googleapis.com/charts"
      values: {}
      wait: helm-deployed
      wait_timeout: 2m
    # Istiod with REGISTRY_ONLY outbound policy
    - kind: helm
      chart: istio/istiod
      version: 1.27.9
      release: istiod
      namespace: istio-system
      repo:
        name: istio
        url: "https://istio-release.storage.googleapis.com/charts"
      values:
        pilot:
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "384Mi"
        meshConfig:
          outboundTrafficPolicy:
            mode: REGISTRY_ONLY
      wait: pods-ready
      wait_timeout: 5m
    # Gateway API CRDs (for consistent istio gateway-api category membership)
    - kind: raw_manifest
      path: https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/gateway-api/releases/download/v1.2.0/standard-install.yaml
    # Egress gateway deployment (istio/gateway chart with egressgateway label)
    - kind: helm
      chart: istio/gateway
      version: 1.27.9
      release: istio-egressgateway
      namespace: istio-system
      repo:
        name: istio
        url: "https://istio-release.storage.googleapis.com/charts"
      values:
        service:
          type: ClusterIP
        labels:
          istio: egressgateway
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: "50m"
            memory: "128Mi"
      wait: pods-ready
      wait_timeout: 3m
    # Istio egress Gateway resource (configures the egress gateway proxy)
    - kind: raw_manifest
      path: ./fixtures/istio-egress-gateway.yaml
      namespace: istio-system
    # ServiceEntry + VirtualService for httpbin.org (in product namespace)
    - kind: raw_manifest
      path: ./fixtures/istio-egress-service-entry.yaml
      namespace: sample
product:
  chart: ./chart
  release: sample
  namespace: sample
  set:
    image.repository: "nginx"
    image.tag: "1.27-alpine"
    mesh.inject: "true"
asserts:
  - type: helm-status-deployed
    release: istio-base
    namespace: istio-system
  - type: helm-status-deployed
    release: istiod
    namespace: istio-system
  - type: helm-status-deployed
    release: istio-egressgateway
    namespace: istio-system
  - type: helm-status-deployed
    release: sample
    namespace: sample
  - type: pods-ready
    namespace: istio-system
    selector: app=istiod
    timeout: 5m
  - type: pods-ready
    namespace: istio-system
    selector: istio=egressgateway
    timeout: 3m
  - type: pods-ready
    namespace: sample
    timeout: 5m
  - type: smoke-script
    path: chart-test/assertions/istio-gateway-api-egress.sh
tags: [nightly]
mechanisms: ['addon:istio', 'gateway-api:istio-egress']
category: gateway-api
integration: istio-egress
tier: live

---
# Istio Gateway: configures the egress gateway proxy to listen for httpbin.org
# Applied in the istio-system namespace alongside the egress gateway deployment.
apiVersion: networking.istio.io/v1beta1
kind: Gateway
metadata:
  name: egressgateway
  namespace: istio-system
spec:
  selector:
    istio: egressgateway
  servers:
    - port:
        number: 80
        name: http
        protocol: HTTP
      hosts:
        - httpbin.org
istio-egress-service-entry.yaml 1248 B · 51 ln

---
# ServiceEntry: registers httpbin.org as an external service in the mesh
# Applied in the sample namespace where the product workload runs.
apiVersion: networking.istio.io/v1beta1
kind: ServiceEntry
metadata:
  name: httpbin-external
  namespace: sample
spec:
  hosts:
    - httpbin.org
  ports:
    - number: 80
      name: http
      protocol: HTTP
  resolution: DNS
  location: MESH_EXTERNAL
---
# VirtualService: routes mesh sidecar traffic for httpbin.org through the
# egress gateway, then from the egress gateway to the external host.
# Both "mesh" and the egress gateway must be listed in gateways.
apiVersion: networking.istio.io/v1beta1
kind: VirtualService
metadata:
  name: httpbin-via-egress
  namespace: sample
spec:
  hosts:
    - httpbin.org
  gateways:
    - istio-system/egressgateway
    - mesh
  http:
    - match:
        - gateways:
            - mesh
          port: 80
      route:
        - destination:
            host: istio-egressgateway.istio-system.svc.cluster.local
          weight: 100
    - match:
        - gateways:
            - istio-system/egressgateway
          port: 80
      route:
        - destination:
            host: httpbin.org
            port:
              number: 80
          weight: 100

---
id: gateway-api-istio-gateway-api-backend-tls-policy
name: "Istio Gateway API BackendTLSPolicy"
description: >-
  Installs istio/base + istio/istiod and Gateway API CRDs, generates self-signed TLS certs at runtime, creates BackendTLSPolicy targeting the Service, and verifies Policy acceptance and gateway routing.
labels: {customer: any, profile: gateway-api-backendtls}
cluster:
  provider: kind
  k8s_version: v1.30.0
  preinstall:
    - kind: helm
      chart: istio/base
      version: 1.27.9
      release: istio-base
      namespace: istio-system
      repo:
        name: istio
        url: "https://istio-release.storage.googleapis.com/charts"
      values: {}
      wait: helm-deployed
      wait_timeout: 2m
    - kind: helm
      chart: istio/istiod
      version: 1.27.9
      release: istiod
      namespace: istio-system
      repo:
        name: istio
        url: "https://istio-release.storage.googleapis.com/charts"
      values:
        pilot:
          env:
            PILOT_ENABLE_ALPHA_GATEWAY_API: "true"
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "384Mi"
      wait: pods-ready
      wait_timeout: 5m
    - kind: raw_manifest
      path: https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/gateway-api/releases/download/v1.2.0/standard-install.yaml
    - kind: raw_manifest
      path: https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/gateway-api/releases/download/v1.2.0/experimental-install.yaml
product:
  chart: ./chart
  release: sample
  namespace: sample
  set:
    image.repository: "nginx"
    image.tag: "1.27-alpine"
    gatewayRoute.enabled: "false"
    gatewayRoute.parentRef.name: "sample-gw"
    gatewayRoute.parentRef.sectionName: "http"
asserts:
  - type: helm-status-deployed
    release: istio-base
    namespace: istio-system
  - type: helm-status-deployed
    release: istiod
    namespace: istio-system
  - type: helm-status-deployed
    release: sample
    namespace: sample
  - type: pods-ready
    namespace: istio-system
    selector: app=istiod
    timeout: 5m
  - type: smoke-script
    path: chart-test/assertions/istio-gateway-api-gen-backend-tls-certs.sh
  - type: pods-ready
    namespace: sample
    timeout: 5m
  - type: smoke-script
    path: chart-test/assertions/istio-gateway-api-backend-tls-policy.sh
tags: [nightly]
mechanisms: ['addon:istio', 'gateway-api:istio']
category: gateway-api
integration: istio
tier: live

helm_values:
  {replicaCount: 1, image: {repository: nginx, tag: "1.27-alpine"}, service: {type: ClusterIP, port: 80}, tls: {enabled: false, secretName: "", servicePort: 443,
      # -- Filesystem path where TLS cert+key are mounted. Defaults to /etc/tls.
      mountPath: "",
      # -- Volume type for the TLS material. Supported: secret (default), persistentVolumeClaim, projected, csi.
      volumeType: "secret",
      # -- PVC claim name (required when volumeType is persistentVolumeClaim).
      pvcClaimName: "",
      # -- SecretProviderClass name (required when volumeType is csi).
      secretProviderClass: "",
      # -- Whether to run the wait-for-tls initContainer that polls for cert files. Disable for CSI volumes that are populated asynchronously.
      waitForCerts: true},
    # -- Scope component (API server). Creates a separate Deployment + Service on port 8080.
    scope: {enabled: false, replicaCount: 1, image: {repository: nginx, tag: "1.27-alpine"}, service: {port: 8080}},
    # -- Darkroom component (async processor). Creates a separate Deployment with optional PVC mount.
    darkroom: {enabled: false, replicaCount: 1, image: {repository: nginx, tag: "1.27-alpine"}, pvc: {enabled: false, claimName: "", mountPath: /data}},
    # -- Ingress resource for skywatcher Service.
    ingress: {enabled: false, className: "nginx", host: "", path: /, pathType: Prefix},
    # -- HTTPRoute resource for Gateway API integration.
    gatewayRoute: {enabled: false, parentRef: {name: envoy, namespace: "", sectionName: ""}, hostname: ""},
    # -- Service mesh integration.
    mesh: {inject: false},
    # -- Policy compliance labels applied to pod templates.

id: gateway-api-istio-gateway-api-basic
name: "Istio Gateway API Basic"
description: "Installs istio/base + istio/istiod and Gateway API CRDs, creates GatewayClass istio + Gateway + HTTPRoute, and verifies HTTP routing through auto-provisioned Istio data-plane."
labels: {customer: any, profile: gateway-api}
cluster:
  provider: kind
  k8s_version: v1.30.0
  preinstall:
    - kind: helm
      chart: istio/base
      version: 1.27.9
      release: istio-base
      namespace: istio-system
      repo:
        name: istio
        url: "https://istio-release.storage.googleapis.com/charts"
      values: {}
      wait: helm-deployed
      wait_timeout: 2m
    - kind: helm
      chart: istio/istiod
      version: 1.27.9
      release: istiod
      namespace: istio-system
      repo:
        name: istio
        url: "https://istio-release.storage.googleapis.com/charts"
      values:
        pilot:
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "384Mi"
      wait: pods-ready
      wait_timeout: 5m
    - kind: raw_manifest
      path: https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/gateway-api/releases/download/v1.2.0/standard-install.yaml
product:
  chart: ./chart
  release: sample
  namespace: sample
  set:
    image.repository: "nginx"
    image.tag: "1.27-alpine"
    gatewayRoute.enabled: "true"
    gatewayRoute.parentRef.name: "sample-gw"
    gatewayRoute.parentRef.sectionName: "http"
asserts:
  - type: helm-status-deployed
    release: istio-base
    namespace: istio-system
  - type: helm-status-deployed
    release: istiod
    namespace: istio-system
  - type: helm-status-deployed
    release: sample
    namespace: sample
  - type: pods-ready
    namespace: istio-system
    selector: app=istiod
    timeout: 5m
  - type: pods-ready
    namespace: sample
    timeout: 5m
  - type: smoke-script
    path: chart-test/assertions/istio-gateway-api-basic.sh
tags: [nightly, curated-live]
mechanisms: ['addon:istio', 'gateway-api:istio']
category: gateway-api
integration: istio
tier: live

  {replicaCount: 1, image: {repository: nginx, tag: "1.27-alpine"}, service: {type: ClusterIP, port: 80}, tls: {enabled: false, secretName: "", servicePort: 443,
      # -- Filesystem path where TLS cert+key are mounted. Defaults to /etc/tls.
      mountPath: "",
      # -- Volume type for the TLS material. Supported: secret (default), persistentVolumeClaim, projected, csi.
      volumeType: "secret",
      # -- PVC claim name (required when volumeType is persistentVolumeClaim).
      pvcClaimName: "",
      # -- SecretProviderClass name (required when volumeType is csi).
      secretProviderClass: "",
      # -- Whether to run the wait-for-tls initContainer that polls for cert files. Disable for CSI volumes that are populated asynchronously.
      waitForCerts: true},
    # -- Scope component (API server). Creates a separate Deployment + Service on port 8080.
    scope: {enabled: false, replicaCount: 1, image: {repository: nginx, tag: "1.27-alpine"}, service: {port: 8080}},
    # -- Darkroom component (async processor). Creates a separate Deployment with optional PVC mount.
    darkroom: {enabled: false, replicaCount: 1, image: {repository: nginx, tag: "1.27-alpine"}, pvc: {enabled: false, claimName: "", mountPath: /data}},
    # -- Ingress resource for skywatcher Service.
    ingress: {enabled: false, className: "nginx", host: "", path: /, pathType: Prefix},
    # -- HTTPRoute resource for Gateway API integration.
    gatewayRoute: {enabled: false, parentRef: {name: envoy, namespace: "", sectionName: ""}, hostname: ""},
    # -- Service mesh integration.
    mesh: {inject: false},
    # -- Policy compliance labels applied to pod templates.
    policy: {complianceLabels: {}}, image.repository: "nginx", image.tag: "1.27-alpine", gatewayRoute.enabled: "true", gatewayRoute.parentRef.name: "sample-gw", gatewayRoute.parentRef.sectionName: "http"}

cluster:
  provider: kind
  k8s_version: v1.30.0
  preinstall:
    - kind: helm
      chart: istio/base
      version: 1.27.9
      release: istio-base
      namespace: istio-system
      repo:
        name: istio
        url: "https://istio-release.storage.googleapis.com/charts"
      values: {}
      wait: helm-deployed
      wait_timeout: 2m
    - kind: helm
      chart: istio/istiod
      version: 1.27.9
      release: istiod
      namespace: istio-system
      repo:
        name: istio
        url: "https://istio-release.storage.googleapis.com/charts"
      values:
        pilot:
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "384Mi"
      wait: pods-ready
      wait_timeout: 5m
    - kind: raw_manifest
      path: https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/gateway-api/releases/download/v1.2.0/standard-install.yaml
product:
  chart: ./chart
  release: sample
  namespace: sample
  set:
    image.repository: "nginx"
    image.tag: "1.27-alpine"
    gatewayRoute.enabled: "true"
    gatewayRoute.parentRef.name: "sample-gw"
    gatewayRoute.parentRef.sectionName: "http"
asserts:
  - type: helm-status-deployed
    release: istio-base
    namespace: istio-system
  - type: helm-status-deployed
    release: istiod
    namespace: istio-system
  - type: helm-status-deployed
    release: sample
    namespace: sample
  - type: pods-ready
    namespace: istio-system
    selector: app=istiod
    timeout: 5m
  - type: pods-ready
    namespace: sample
    timeout: 5m
  - type: smoke-script
    path: chart-test/assertions/istio-gateway-api-ingress.sh
tags: [nightly]
mechanisms: ['addon:istio', 'gateway-api:istio']
category: gateway-api
integration: istio
tier: live

  {replicaCount: 1, image: {repository: nginx, tag: "1.27-alpine"}, service: {type: ClusterIP, port: 80}, tls: {enabled: false, secretName: "", servicePort: 443,
      # -- Filesystem path where TLS cert+key are mounted. Defaults to /etc/tls.
      mountPath: "",
      # -- Volume type for the TLS material. Supported: secret (default), persistentVolumeClaim, projected, csi.
      volumeType: "secret",
      # -- PVC claim name (required when volumeType is persistentVolumeClaim).
      pvcClaimName: "",
      # -- SecretProviderClass name (required when volumeType is csi).
      secretProviderClass: "",
      # -- Whether to run the wait-for-tls initContainer that polls for cert files. Disable for CSI volumes that are populated asynchronously.
      waitForCerts: true},
    # -- Scope component (API server). Creates a separate Deployment + Service on port 8080.
    scope: {enabled: false, replicaCount: 1, image: {repository: nginx, tag: "1.27-alpine"}, service: {port: 8080}},
    # -- Darkroom component (async processor). Creates a separate Deployment with optional PVC mount.
    darkroom: {enabled: false, replicaCount: 1, image: {repository: nginx, tag: "1.27-alpine"}, pvc: {enabled: false, claimName: "", mountPath: /data}},

imagepullsecrets-off Capability: no imagePullSecrets when unset (OFF) PASS
Description
Renders the product chart with default values (no imagePullSecrets overrides) and asserts that no workload pod spec and no ServiceAccount carries an imagePullSecrets field. Since the chart has no imagePullSecrets templates, none should appear. This scenario is EXPECTED to PASS — confirming no imagePullSecrets leakage when the knob is off.

kind
Mechanisms
capability:imagepullsecrets
Tags
capabilitycompliance
Labels
customer=enterprise profile=compliance
Artifacts
Scenario YAML
scenario.yaml 899 B · 24 ln
View full file 
---
id: imagepullsecrets-off
name: "Capability: no imagePullSecrets when unset (OFF)"
description: >-
  Renders the product chart with default values (no imagePullSecrets overrides) and asserts that no workload pod spec and no ServiceAccount carries an imagePullSecrets field. Since the chart has no imagePullSecrets templates, none should appear. This scenario is EXPECTED to PASS — confirming no imagePullSecrets leakage when the knob is off.
labels: {customer: enterprise, profile: compliance}
cluster:
  provider: kind
  k8s_version: v1.30.0
product:
  chart: ./chart
  release: sample
  namespace: sample
asserts:
  - type: imagepullsecrets-present
    namespace: sample
    source: rendered
    expect_present: false
    check_service_account: true
tags: [capability, compliance]
category: capability
capability: imagepullsecrets
tier: capability
mechanisms: ["capability:imagepullsecrets"]

---
id: imagepullsecrets-on
name: "Capability: imagePullSecrets propagate to every pod spec + ServiceAccount (ON)"
description: >-
  Renders the product chart with imagePullSecrets[0].name=regcred configured and asserts that every workload pod spec carries the imagePullSecrets entry and the chart ServiceAccount also carries it. The sample chart does NOT include an imagePullSecrets field in any template (no Deployment pod spec, no ServiceAccount template). Setting imagePullSecrets has no effect. This scenario is EXPECTED to FAIL (honest red gap) documenting that the chart lacks imagePullSecrets knobs on both pod specs and ServiceAccount.
labels: {customer: enterprise, profile: compliance}
cluster:
  provider: kind
  k8s_version: v1.30.0
product:
  chart: ./chart
  release: sample
  namespace: sample
  set:
    imagePullSecrets[0].name: regcred
asserts:
  - type: imagepullsecrets-present
    namespace: sample
    source: rendered
    expect_present: true
    secret_names:
      - regcred
    check_service_account: true
tags: [capability, compliance]
category: capability
capability: imagepullsecrets
tier: capability
mechanisms: ["capability:imagepullsecrets"]

---
id: ingress-controllers-contour-basic-httpproxy
name: "Contour basic HTTPProxy (gap-probe)"
description: >-
  Installs Contour, creates an HTTPProxy for the product Service via fixture, and verifies HTTP routing through the envoy pod IP with Host header matching and HTTPProxy status valid. Then runs a gap-probe: the chart does NOT natively emit a Contour HTTPProxy CRD — the HTTPProxy was created by the fixture, not by a chart template. This is an honest gap (red cell); do NOT over-engineer the chart.
labels: {customer: any, profile: ingress}
cluster:
  provider: kind
  k8s_version: v1.30.0
  preinstall:
    - kind: helm
      chart: projectcontour/contour
      version: "0.6.0"
      release: contour
      namespace: projectcontour
      repo:
        name: projectcontour
        url: "https://projectcontour.github.io/helm-charts"
      wait: pods-ready
      wait_timeout: 3m
    - kind: raw_manifest
      path: ./fixtures/contour-basic-httpproxy.yaml
      namespace: sample
product:
  chart: ./chart
  release: sample
  namespace: sample
  set:
    image.repository: "public.ecr.aws/nginx/nginx"
    image.tag: "1.27-alpine"
    ingress.enabled: "false"
asserts:
  - type: helm-status-deployed
    release: sample
    namespace: sample
  - type: pods-ready
    namespace: sample
    timeout: 5m
  - type: pods-ready
    namespace: projectcontour
    timeout: 3m
  - type: smoke-script
    path: chart-test/assertions/contour-basic.sh
tags: [nightly, curated-live]
mechanisms: ['addon:contour']
category: networking
integration: contour
tier: live

---
id: ingress-controllers-contour-rate-limit
name: "Contour rate limit"
description: "Installs Contour, creates an HTTPProxy with local rateLimitPolicy (5 req/min), and verifies that exceeding the limit produces 429 responses while requests within the limit succeed."
labels: {customer: any, profile: ingress}
cluster:
  provider: kind
  k8s_version: v1.30.0
  preinstall:
    - kind: helm
      chart: projectcontour/contour
      version: "0.6.0"
      release: contour
      namespace: projectcontour
      repo:
        name: projectcontour
        url: "https://projectcontour.github.io/helm-charts"
      wait: pods-ready
      wait_timeout: 3m
    - kind: raw_manifest
      path: ./fixtures/contour-rate-limit-httpproxy.yaml
      namespace: sample
product:
  chart: ./chart
  release: sample
  namespace: sample
  set:
    image.repository: "public.ecr.aws/nginx/nginx"
    image.tag: "1.27-alpine"
    ingress.enabled: "false"
asserts:
  - type: helm-status-deployed
    release: sample
    namespace: sample
  - type: pods-ready
    namespace: sample
    timeout: 5m
  - type: pods-ready
    namespace: projectcontour
    timeout: 3m
  - type: smoke-script
    path: chart-test/assertions/contour-rate-limit.sh
tags: [nightly]
mechanisms: ['addon:contour']
category: networking
integration: contour
tier: live

id: ingress-controllers-contour-tls-delegation
name: "Contour TLS delegation"
description: "Installs Contour, deploys TLS Secret in tls-secrets NS, grants cross-namespace access via TLSCertificateDelegation, creates HTTPProxy with delegated Secret, verifies HTTPS 200."
labels: {customer: any, profile: ingress}
cluster:
  provider: kind
  k8s_version: v1.30.0
  preinstall:
    - kind: helm
      chart: projectcontour/contour
      version: "0.6.0"
      release: contour
      namespace: projectcontour
      repo:
        name: projectcontour
        url: "https://projectcontour.github.io/helm-charts"
      wait: pods-ready
      wait_timeout: 3m
    - kind: raw_manifest
      path: ./fixtures/contour-tls-delegation-ns.yaml
    - kind: raw_manifest
      path: ./fixtures/contour-tls-delegation-certdelegation.yaml
      namespace: tls-secrets
    - kind: raw_manifest
      path: ./fixtures/contour-tls-delegation-httpproxy.yaml
      namespace: sample
product:
  chart: ./chart
  release: sample
  namespace: sample
  set:
    image.repository: "public.ecr.aws/nginx/nginx"
    image.tag: "1.27-alpine"
    ingress.enabled: "false"
asserts:
  - type: helm-status-deployed
    release: sample
    namespace: sample
  - type: pods-ready
    namespace: sample
    timeout: 5m
  - type: pods-ready
    namespace: projectcontour
    timeout: 3m
  - type: smoke-script
    path: chart-test/assertions/contour-tls-delegation.sh
tags: [nightly]
mechanisms: ['addon:contour']
category: networking
integration: contour
tier: live

      # -- Filesystem path where TLS cert+key are mounted. Defaults to /etc/tls.
      mountPath: "",
      # -- Volume type for the TLS material. Supported: secret (default), persistentVolumeClaim, projected, csi.
      volumeType: "secret",
      # -- PVC claim name (required when volumeType is persistentVolumeClaim).
      pvcClaimName: "",
      # -- SecretProviderClass name (required when volumeType is csi).
      secretProviderClass: "",
      # -- Whether to run the wait-for-tls initContainer that polls for cert files. Disable for CSI volumes that are populated asynchronously.
      waitForCerts: true},
    # -- Scope component (API server). Creates a separate Deployment + Service on port 8080.
    scope: {enabled: false, replicaCount: 1, image: {repository: nginx, tag: "1.27-alpine"}, service: {port: 8080}},
    # -- Darkroom component (async processor). Creates a separate Deployment with optional PVC mount.
    darkroom: {enabled: false, replicaCount: 1, image: {repository: nginx, tag: "1.27-alpine"}, pvc: {enabled: false, claimName: "", mountPath: /data}},
    # -- Ingress resource for skywatcher Service.
    ingress: {enabled: false, className: "nginx", host: "", path: /, pathType: Prefix},
    # -- HTTPRoute resource for Gateway API integration.
    gatewayRoute: {enabled: false, parentRef: {name: envoy, namespace: "", sectionName: ""}, hostname: ""},
    # -- Service mesh integration.
    mesh: {inject: false},
    # -- Policy compliance labels applied to pod templates.
    policy: {complianceLabels: {}}, image.repository: "public.ecr.aws/nginx/nginx", image.tag: "1.27-alpine", ingress.enabled: "false"}

---
apiVersion: projectcontour.io/v1
kind: TLSCertificateDelegation
metadata:
  name: sample-tls-delegation
  namespace: tls-secrets
spec:
  delegations:
    - secretName: sample-tls
      targetNamespaces:
        - "sample"

---
apiVersion: projectcontour.io/v1
kind: HTTPProxy
metadata:
  name: sample-tls
  namespace: sample
spec:
  virtualhost:
    fqdn: sample.test.local
    tls:
      secretName: tls-secrets/sample-tls
  routes:
    - conditions:
        - prefix: /
      services:
        - name: sample
          port: 80

scenario.yaml 1664 B · 60 ln

---
id: ingress-controllers-nginx-ingress-basic
name: "NGINX Ingress basic routing"
description: "Installs NGINX Ingress controller, creates an Ingress with ingressClassName: nginx, and verifies Host-header routing returns HTTP 200."
labels: {customer: any, profile: ingress}
cluster:
  provider: kind
  k8s_version: v1.30.0
  preinstall:
    - kind: helm
      chart: ingress-nginx/ingress-nginx
      version: "4.10.0"
      release: ingress-nginx
      namespace: ingress-nginx
      repo:
        name: ingress-nginx
        url: "https://kubernetes.github.io/ingress-nginx"
      values:
        controller:
          service:
            type: NodePort
          allowSnippetAnnotations: true
          ingressClassResource:
            name: nginx
            enabled: true
            default: false
            controllerValue: "k8s.io/ingress-nginx"
          watchIngressWithoutClass: true
        admissionWebhooks:
          enabled: false
      wait: pods-ready
      wait_timeout: 3m
    - kind: raw_manifest
      path: ./fixtures/nginx-basic-ingress.yaml
      namespace: sample
product:
  chart: ./chart
  release: sample
  namespace: sample
  set:
    image.repository: "public.ecr.aws/nginx/nginx"
    image.tag: "1.27-alpine"
    ingress.enabled: "false"
asserts:
  - type: helm-status-deployed
    release: sample
    namespace: sample
  - type: pods-ready
    namespace: sample
    timeout: 5m
  - type: pods-ready
    namespace: ingress-nginx
    timeout: 3m
  - type: smoke-script
    path: chart-test/assertions/nginx-basic.sh
tags: [nightly]
mechanisms: ['addon:nginx-ingress']
category: networking
integration: nginx-ingress
tier: live

    scope: {enabled: false, replicaCount: 1, image: {repository: nginx, tag: "1.27-alpine"}, service: {port: 8080}},

scenario.yaml 1826 B · 63 ln

---
id: ingress-controllers-nginx-ingress-canary
name: "NGINX Ingress canary traffic splitting"
description: "Installs NGINX Ingress controller with stable+canary Ingresses (canary-weight=20), deploys a canary backend with distinctive response, verifies ~20% of 100 probes hit canary."
labels: {customer: any, profile: ingress}
cluster:
  provider: kind
  k8s_version: v1.30.0
  preinstall:
    - kind: helm
      chart: ingress-nginx/ingress-nginx
      version: "4.10.0"
      release: ingress-nginx
      namespace: ingress-nginx
      repo:
        name: ingress-nginx
        url: "https://kubernetes.github.io/ingress-nginx"
      values:
        controller:
          service:
            type: NodePort
          allowSnippetAnnotations: true
          ingressClassResource:
            name: nginx
            enabled: true
            default: false
            controllerValue: "k8s.io/ingress-nginx"
          watchIngressWithoutClass: true
        admissionWebhooks:
          enabled: false
      wait: pods-ready
      wait_timeout: 3m
    - kind: raw_manifest
      path: ./fixtures/nginx-canary-stable-ingress.yaml
      namespace: sample
    - kind: raw_manifest
      path: ./fixtures/nginx-canary-deployment.yaml
      namespace: sample
product:
  chart: ./chart
  release: sample
  namespace: sample
  set:
    image.repository: "public.ecr.aws/nginx/nginx"
    image.tag: "1.27-alpine"
    ingress.enabled: "false"
asserts:
  - type: helm-status-deployed
    release: sample
    namespace: sample
  - type: pods-ready
    namespace: sample
    timeout: 5m
  - type: pods-ready
    namespace: ingress-nginx
    timeout: 3m
  - type: smoke-script
    path: chart-test/assertions/nginx-canary.sh
tags: [nightly]
mechanisms: ['addon:nginx-ingress']
category: networking
integration: nginx-ingress
tier: live

---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: sample-canary
  namespace: sample
  labels:
    app: sample-canary
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: sample-canary
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: sample-canary
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: canary-backend
          image: public.ecr.aws/nginx/nginx:1.27-alpine
          ports:
            - containerPort: 80
          volumeMounts:
            - name: canary-config
              mountPath: /etc/nginx/conf.d
      volumes:
        - name: canary-config
          configMap:
            name: canary-backend-config
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: canary-backend-config
  namespace: sample
data:
  default.conf: |
    server {
      listen 80;
      server_name _;
      location / {
        add_header X-Backend canary;
        return 200 'canary-response';
        add_header Content-Type text/plain;
      }
    }
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: sample-canary
  namespace: sample
spec:
  selector:
    app: sample-canary
  ports:
    - port: 80
      targetPort: 80
---
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: sample-canary
  namespace: sample
  annotations:
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/canary: "true"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/canary-weight: "20"
spec:
  ingressClassName: nginx
  rules:
    - host: sample.test.local
      http:
        paths:
          - path: /
            pathType: Prefix
            backend:
              service:
                name: sample-canary
                port:
                  number: 80

scenario.yaml 1939 B · 65 ln

---
id: ingress-controllers-nginx-ingress-default-backend
name: "NGINX Ingress custom default backend"
description: "Installs NGINX Ingress with custom default backend Deployment+Service, verifies requests without matching Host return the custom backend's distinctive body instead of stock 404."
labels: {customer: any, profile: ingress}
cluster:
  provider: kind
  k8s_version: v1.30.0
  preinstall:
    - kind: raw_manifest
      path: ./fixtures/nginx-default-backend.yaml
      namespace: ingress-nginx
    - kind: helm
      chart: ingress-nginx/ingress-nginx
      version: "4.10.0"
      release: ingress-nginx
      namespace: ingress-nginx
      repo:
        name: ingress-nginx
        url: "https://kubernetes.github.io/ingress-nginx"
      values:
        controller:
          service:
            type: NodePort
          allowSnippetAnnotations: true
          ingressClassResource:
            name: nginx
            enabled: true
            default: false
            controllerValue: "k8s.io/ingress-nginx"
          watchIngressWithoutClass: true
          extraArgs:
            default-backend-service: "ingress-nginx/custom-default-backend"
        admissionWebhooks:
          enabled: false
      wait: pods-ready
      wait_timeout: 3m
    - kind: raw_manifest
      path: ./fixtures/nginx-basic-ingress.yaml
      namespace: sample
product:
  chart: ./chart
  release: sample
  namespace: sample
  set:
    image.repository: "public.ecr.aws/nginx/nginx"
    image.tag: "1.27-alpine"
    ingress.enabled: "false"
asserts:
  - type: helm-status-deployed
    release: sample
    namespace: sample
  - type: pods-ready
    namespace: sample
    timeout: 5m
  - type: pods-ready
    namespace: ingress-nginx
    timeout: 3m
  - type: smoke-script
    path: chart-test/assertions/nginx-default-backend.sh
tags: [nightly]
mechanisms: ['addon:nginx-ingress']
category: networking
integration: nginx-ingress
tier: live

---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: ingress-nginx
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: custom-default-backend
  namespace: ingress-nginx
  labels:
    app: custom-default-backend
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: custom-default-backend
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: custom-default-backend
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: default-backend
          image: public.ecr.aws/nginx/nginx:1.27-alpine
          ports:
            - containerPort: 80
          volumeMounts:
            - name: nginx-config
              mountPath: /etc/nginx/conf.d
      volumes:
        - name: nginx-config
          configMap:
            name: custom-default-backend-config
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: custom-default-backend-config
  namespace: ingress-nginx
data:
  default.conf: |
    server {
      listen 80 default_server;
      server_name _;
      location / {
        return 200 'chart-test-swarm-default-backend';
        add_header Content-Type text/plain;
      }
    }
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: custom-default-backend
  namespace: ingress-nginx
spec:
  selector:
    app: custom-default-backend
  ports:
    - port: 80
      targetPort: 80

scenario.yaml 1738 B · 60 ln
